question: Who among the following musicians was shortlisted for the Bharat Ratna in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhupen Hazarika**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Bhupen Hazarika was an eminent Indian playback singer, lyricist, musician, poet, and filmmaker from Assam.
 
• He was awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award, posthumously in 2019.
 
• Hazarika's songs, written and sung mainly in the Assamese language, are marked by themes of humanity and universal brotherhood.
 
• He was also known for his contributions to Assamese cinema and his role in popularizing Assamese folk music.
 
• Bhupen Hazarika served as the chairman of the Sangeet Natak Akademi from December 1998 to December 2003.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharat Ratna**

 
 
• It is the highest civilian award of the Republic of India, instituted in 1954.
 
• The award recognizes exceptional service/performance of the highest order in any field of human endeavor.
 
• It does not carry any monetary grant but consists of a medallion and a certificate.
 
• As of 2023, only 48 individuals have been awarded the Bharat Ratna.
 
 
 
• **Assamese Folk Music**
 
 
• Assamese folk music includes various forms like Bihu songs, Borgeet, and Zikir.
 
• Bihu songs are traditionally sung during the Bihu festival, marking the Assamese New Year.
 
• Borgeet are devotional songs composed by Srimanta Sankardev and Madhavdev.
 
• Zikir are songs that promote communal harmony and were composed by Azan Fakir.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi**
 
 
• It is India's national academy for music, dance, and drama.
 
• Established in 1952, it aims to promote and preserve India's cultural heritage.
 
• The Akademi conducts various programs, workshops, and awards to recognize excellence in performing arts.
 
• The chairman serves a term of five years and is appointed by the President of India.
 
 
 
• **Posthumous Awards**
 
 
• Posthumous awards are honors given after the recipient's death.
 
• They recognize the contributions and legacy of individuals who have significantly impacted their field.
 
• In India, several high-profile awards, including the Bharat Ratna, have been given posthumously.
 
• These awards serve as a tribute to the recipient's enduring influence and achievements.
